rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Fay, Dev, Ben, Cal, Eli, Ada. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Fay.say: Proposal for every round: each of us claims exactly 1 token from the bank. The bank will have at least 8 tokens against 6 claims, so everyone gets 1, spends it to survive, and nobody is left short. Anyone who grabs more starves someone else later, so let's all keep to 1.

Dev.say: Dev here. Proposal: everyone claims only 1 token this round. The bank holds 6 plus a delivery of 2 to 6, so 6 single claims fit in full, everyone survives the round, and the rest stays in the bank for later rounds. Greedy claims would shrink everyone's share and leave us short later. I'm claiming 1.

Ben.say: Proposal for everyone: claim exactly 1 token per round. That is all anyone needs to survive, and with 6 in the bank plus a delivery of at least 2, every claim of 1 is paid in full. Taking more risks proportional cuts that could leave people out.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. The bank should have 8 to 12 available, so all six of us can cover this round's spend without taking more than we need. Taking more only leaves someone short. Let's keep claims modest so everyone survives early rounds.

Ada.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 this round. The bank will hold at least 8 after delivery, so six claims of 1 all fit and everyone survives the round. Over-claiming only shrinks the bank for everyone, and we all need 5 tokens in total to last.

Still, claiming 1 is the minimum we need and keeps the split as fair as possible. Let's all claim 1.
